opponent.description: Korra is the Avatar who succeeds Avatar Aang and precedes Avatar Pavi. She was born and raised in the Southern Water Tribe, where she mastered waterbending, earthbending, and firebending. She later relocated to Republic City to attain a similar proficiency with airbending. Beneath her tough exterior, she possesses a strong loyalty towards her friends and duty as the Avatar.
